user_journeys.title: Create an encrypted document, restart, find it, and reopen it

acceptance_criteria.statement: The Android app completes the journey through its installed UI after a process-style restart.
The iOS simulator app completes the journey through its installed UI after relaunch.
Stored document bytes are encrypted, context-bound, integrity checked, and readable after restart.
Only authorized verified active metadata is searchable and opens the intended document.

user_journeys.title: Record activity, derive cadence, schedule a reminder, and survive restart and timezone change

acceptance_criteria.statement: Deterministic shared contracts prove activity, cadence, scheduling, restart, and timezone behavior.
The installed Android app completes the activity and reminder journey.
The installed iOS simulator app completes the activity and reminder journey.

user_journeys.title: Link a document to an activity and find both through federated search

acceptance_criteria.statement: Typed links and federated search are deterministic and authorization preserving.
The installed Android app creates a typed link and opens both linked records from search.
The installed iOS simulator app creates a typed link and opens both linked records from search.
